content: विवृत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Displayed, manifested, expressed. .²2 Evident, clear, open. .²3 Uncovered, exposed, laid bare; ज्ञातास्वादो विवृतजघनां को विहातुं समर्थः <ls>Me. 43</ls>. .²4 Opened, unclosed, bare, open; कृष्णायसं च विवृतं धारयन् मुच्यते द्विजः <ls>Mb. 13. 136. 6</ls>. .²5 Proclaimed. .²6 Expounded, explained, commented upon; विवृत इव निरुक्तः <ls>Bhāg. 12. 11. 24</ls>. .²7 Expanded, spread out. .²8 Extensive, large, spacious. .²9 Bare, barren (as ground). .²10 Unhurt, woundless; <ls>Mb. 4</ls>. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Open articulation. .²2 Publicity. .{@-ता@} A particular disease, ulcer. .{@-तम्@} {%ind.%} Openly.
